repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了30,000+行关于主流AI编程工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Devin AI等）的系统提示、内部工具和模型架构的深度解析，涵盖其设计理念、功能实现与技术细节，为开发者提供全面的AI编程助手技术洞察与最佳实践参考。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains over 30,000 lines of insights into system prompts, internal tools, and AI models of major AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI), offering deep technical analysis of their architecture, functionality, and design principles for developers seeking to understand and leverage AI-powered development tools.

repos.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
repos.summary_zh: OpenCut 是一款免费开源的视频编辑器，支持网页、桌面和移动端，提供时间轴编辑、多轨道支持、实时预览等功能，无水印且无需订阅。注重隐私保护，所有视频处理在本地完成，核心功能对标 CapCut，适合追求简洁高效的用户。
repos.summary_en: OpenCut is a free, open-source video editor for web, desktop, and mobile, offering timeline-based editing, multi-track support, and real-time preview. It emphasizes privacy by processing videos locally, avoids watermarks, and targets users seeking CapCut-like simplicity without paywalled features.

repos.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
repos.summary_zh: Orca 是一款下一代 AI 智能体开发 IDE，支持在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上并行运行 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等多种 CLI 编码智能体。每个智能体独立工作树，统一管理与追踪，专为提升开发者 100 倍效率而设计。
repos.summary_en: Orca is a next-gen IDE for building with coding agents, enabling side-by-side execution of multiple CLI agents like Claude Code and OpenCode on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Each agent operates in its own worktree, centrally tracked and managed for maximum developer productivity.

repos.description: Autonomous coding agent as an SDK, IDE extension, or CLI assistant.
repos.summary_zh: Cline 是一款集成在 IDE 中的自主编码代理，基于 Claude Sonnet 的代理能力，支持文件创建/编辑、终端命令执行、浏览器操作等，全程需用户授权。通过 AST 分析、正则搜索和上下文管理，可处理复杂开发任务，支持 MCP 扩展工具，提供安全的 AI 编程辅助。
repos.summary_en: Cline is an autonomous coding agent integrated directly into your IDE, powered by Claude Sonnet's agentic capabilities. It can create/edit files, execute terminal commands, use browsers, and more—with your permission at every step. Designed for complex software development tasks through AST analysis, regex searches, and context-aware workflows, it extends functionality via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while maintaining human oversight for safety.

repos.description: :atom: The hackable text editor
repos.summary_zh: Atom 是一款基于 Electron 构建的现代化可定制文本编辑器，专为 21 世纪开发者设计。它融合了经典编辑器的优点，支持深度自定义但默认配置友好易用，适用于跨平台开发环境。
repos.summary_en: Atom is a hackable, modern text editor built on Electron, designed for deep customization while remaining approachable. It combines the best features of traditional editors with a flexible, open-source architecture for developers.

repos.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
repos.summary_zh: Free Claude Code 是一个轻量级代理工具，允许用户通过自托管的 Anthropic 兼容代理，免费或低成本使用 Claude Code 的 CLI、VSCode 扩展及 Discord 机器人。支持多模型路由、流式响应、工具调用、语音转录，并提供本地管理界面，兼容 NVIDIA NIM、Ollama、DeepSeek 等主流后端。
repos.summary_en: Free Claude Code is a lightweight proxy enabling free or low-cost access to Claude Code via self-hosted Anthropic-compatible backends. It supports CLI, VSCode, and Discord integrations with multi-provider routing, streaming, tool use, voice transcription, and a local admin UI for configuration.

repos.description: Agent skills for Obsidian. Teach your agent to use Obsidian CLI and open formats including Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供专为 Obsidian 设计的 Agent 技能集，支持 Markdown、Bases、JSON Canvas 和 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 框架，实现知识管理与自动化处理的无缝集成。
repos.summary_en: This repo delivers agent skills for Obsidian, enabling creation and editing of Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas files, and CLI interactions. Fully compatible with Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode via the Agent Skills specification.

repos.description: Free, simple, and intuitive online database diagram editor and SQL generator.
repos.summary_zh: DrawDB 是一款免费、简洁且直观的免费在线数据库关系图编辑器，支持可视化设计数据库结构并自动生成 SQL 脚本。用户无需注册即可直接在浏览器中创建、编辑和导出数据库模型，适用于快速原型设计、文档绘制和团队协作。
repos.summary_en: DrawDB is a free, simple, and intuitive online database schema editor and SQL generator. It enables users to visually design database structures, generate SQL scripts, and export diagrams directly in the browser—no account required. Ideal for rapid prototyping, documentation, and team collaboration.

repos.description: A powerful MCP toolkit for coding, providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities  - the IDE for your agent
repos.summary_zh: Serena 是一个强大的编码代理工具包，通过语义检索和编辑能力（MCP 服务器等集成）将 LLM 转变为可直接操作代码库的全功能代理。它提供类似 IDE 的符号级代码检索与编辑工具，显著提升大模型在代码理解与修改中的效率与准确性，支持多种 LLM 集成方式，包括 MCP、OpenAPI 及自定义代理框架。
repos.summary_en: Serena is a powerful coding agent toolkit that transforms an LLM into a fully-featured agent capable of directly operating on your codebase. It provides IDE-like semantic code retrieval and editing tools at the symbol level, greatly improving token efficiency and code quality. Serena integrates with LLMs via MCP, OpenAPI, or custom agent frameworks, enabling precise code navigation and modification without full-file reads or string replacements.

repos.summary_zh: Void 是一款开源的 Cursor 替代 IDE，支持在代码库中使用 AI 智能体、可视化变更与检查点，并允许本地部署任意模型。其核心优势在于直接与 AI 服务商通信而不保留用户数据，基于 VSCode 深度定制，提供高度可定制的 AI 编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Void is an open-source alternative to Cursor, enabling AI agents to work on your codebase with checkpointing, change visualization, and local model hosting. It communicates directly with AI providers without storing your data, built as a VSCode fork with a focus on innovation over feature parity.

repos.description: The Developer Tool for Visual Engineers • An Open-Source AI-First Design tool • Visually build, style, and edit your code with AI • World's best, top-most agent recommended #1 Developer tool for Designers and Visual Engineers to design with Real Code.
repos.summary_zh: Onlook 是一款面向设计师的开源 AI 驱动可视化代码编辑器，支持在浏览器中实时编辑 React 应用。它结合 Next.js 和 TailwindCSS，提供类 Figma 的 UI 设计体验，实现视觉化开发、实时预览、组件管理和一键部署，是 Bolt.new 等工具的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Onlook is an open-source, AI-first visual code editor for designers, enabling real-time React app editing in the browser. Built with Next.js and TailwindCSS, it offers a Figma-like interface for visual development, component management, and instant deployment, serving as an alternative to tools like Bolt.new.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: Roo Code 是一款 VS Code 扩展，将 AI 智能体团队集成到代码编辑器中，支持自然语言生成代码、多模式协作（编码/架构/调试/问答）、自动化任务处理及文档维护，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Roo Code is a VS Code extension that embeds an AI-powered development team directly into your editor. It enables natural language code generation, multi-mode workflows (coding, architecture, debugging, Q&A), automation, and documentation, dramatically boosting developer productivity.

repos.description: 💻  vibe coding 101｜The first course for AI-native product builders.
repos.summary_zh: 《Easy-Vibe》是面向初学者的现代编程入门课程，主打“会说话就会做应用”的零门槛理念。通过清晰的学习地图与可视化交互教程，帮助新手系统掌握编程技能，避免学完就忘。支持多语言，涵盖从基础到实战的完整路径。
repos.summary_en: Easy-Vibe is a beginner-friendly modern programming course designed to teach coding from scratch with the motto 'if you can talk, you can build apps.' It features a structured learning map and step-by-step visual tutorials to ensure lasting understanding, supported in multiple languages for global accessibility.

repos.description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code/Codex as an AI collaborator in your vault
repos.summary_zh: Claudian 是一款 Obsidian 插件，将 Claude Code 嵌入为 AI 协作者，赋予知识库完整的代理能力：文件读写、搜索、Bash 命令执行和多步工作流。支持上下文感知、图像分析、内联编辑、自定义指令、技能扩展、MCP 集成及高级模型控制，适用于桌面端知识管理与自动化任务处理。
repos.summary_en: Claudian is an Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code as an AI collaborator, enabling full agentic capabilities within your vault: file read/write, search, bash commands, and multi-step workflows. It supports context-awareness, vision via drag-and-drop, inline editing, custom instructions, slash commands, MCP integration, and advanced model control for enhanced knowledge management and automation.

repos.description: Superset is an agentic IDE to orchestrate 100+ coding agents in parallel. Run any agent with your own subscription.
repos.summary_zh: Superset 是专为 AI 智能体时代设计的代码编辑器，支持在本地并行运行多个 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 编码代理。通过 Git 工作树隔离任务、内置终端与差异查看器，实现零切换成本的高效开发流程，显著提升编码效率。
repos.summary_en: Superset is an IDE designed for the AI Agents Era, enabling parallel execution of multiple CLI-based coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on your machine. It isolates tasks via Git worktrees, provides built-in terminal and diff viewer, and eliminates context-switching overhead to boost development efficiency.

repos.description: A search tool helps dev to solve the naming things problem.
repos.summary_zh: CODELF 是一个智能变量命名工具，通过搜索 GitHub 等代码托管平台上的真实项目，为开发者提供精准的变量命名建议。支持 VS Code、Atom、Sublime Text 等编辑器插件，并集成每日算法题推荐功能，同时可管理 GitHub 仓库标签与收藏，显著提升代码命名效率与规范性。
repos.summary_en: CODELF is a smart variable naming tool that helps developers find real-world naming patterns by searching across GitHub and other code repositories. It offers IDE plugins for VS Code, Atom, and Sublime Text, features a daily algorithm practice guide, and includes GitHub repository tagging/organization tools to improve code naming consistency and productivity.

repos.description: ✍ WeChat Markdown Editor | 一款高度简洁的微信 Markdown 编辑器：支持 Markdown 语法、自定义主题样式、内容管理、多图床、AI 助手等特性
repos.summary_zh: Doocs MD 是一款专为微信设计的简洁 Markdown 编辑器，支持完整 Markdown 语法、数学公式、Mermaid 图表、PlantUML 和 Ruby 注音，集成多图床上传与主流 AI 助手，提供自定义主题与本地草稿管理，实现 Markdown 内容一键渲染为美观微信图文。
repos.summary_en: Doocs MD is a minimalist Markdown editor tailored for WeChat, supporting full Markdown syntax, math formulas, Mermaid charts, PlantUML, Ruby annotations, multi-image hosting, and AI assistants. It enables instant rendering of Markdown into visually appealing WeChat articles with customizable themes and local draft management.

repos.description: Automation&Workflow JavaScript IDE on Android(安卓平台上的JavaScript编程IDE)
repos.summary_zh: Auto.js (Pro) 是一款专为 Android 设计的 JavaScript IDE，专注于编程学习与效率提升，支持自动化脚本开发与工作流管理，提供丰富的 API 和可视化工具，适用于移动端自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Auto.js (Pro) is a JavaScript-based IDE for Android, designed for programming education and productivity enhancement. It enables automation scripting and workflow management with rich APIs and visual tools, ideal for mobile automation tasks.

repos.description: 超级速查表 - 编程语言、框架和开发工具的速查表，单个文件包含一切你需要知道的东西 :zap:
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是专为开发者设计的中文速查表集合，涵盖编程语言（如 Bash、Python、Go、JavaScript）、开发工具（如 Git、Gdb、Tmux）和文本编辑器（如 Vim、Emacs）的核心语法与命令，每个速查表均为单个文件，便于快速查阅，解决日常开发中频繁查阅文档的问题。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a curated collection of Chinese cheatsheets for developers, covering programming languages (Bash, Python, Go, JavaScript), development tools (Git, Gdb, Tmux), and text editors (Vim, Emacs). Each cheatsheet is a single-file reference for quick lookup, eliminating the need to search scattered documentation.

repos.description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
repos.summary_zh: Vira Theme 是 Material Theme 的官方继任者，为 VS Code 提供现代化主题与图标套件，包含六种精心设计的深色主题（如 Teal、Ocean、Carbon），支持高度定制与持续更新，专为开发者打造视觉沉浸的编码环境。
repos.summary_en: Vira Theme is the premium successor to Material Theme for VS Code, offering six hand-curated dark themes and icons with enhanced customization, modern aesthetics, and continuous updates for an immersive developer experience.

repos.description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
repos.summary_zh: Vira Theme 是热门 Material Theme 的官方升级版本，作为高端主题持续维护，提供精心策划的图标库及增强功能，适用于现代化 UI 设计与开发。
repos.summary_en: Vira Theme is the premium successor to the popular Material Theme, actively maintained with hand-curated icons and enhanced features for modern UI design and development.

repos.description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
repos.summary_zh: Vira Theme 是广受欢迎的 Material Theme 的官方继任者，提供精心设计的图标和丰富功能。该仓库为 Vira Software 的公共资源库，包含主题资产及设计工具相关素材，支持设计系统一致性与高效开发。
repos.summary_en: Vira Theme is the official successor to the popular Material Theme, offering curated icons and enhanced features. This repository hosts public assets for Vira Software, including theme resources and design tools, supporting consistent design systems and efficient development.

repos.description: ✍️ A static blog writing client (一个静态博客写作客户端)
repos.summary_zh: Gridea 是一款跨平台静态博客写作客户端，支持 Markdown 编辑、多语言界面、主题定制及 Gitalk/DisqusJS 评论系统。用户可本地创作并一键发布至 GitHub Pages 等平台，集成 OneDrive/iCloud 实现多设备同步，适合个人知识管理与内容创作。
repos.summary_en: Gridea is a cross-platform static blog writing client that supports Markdown editing, multi-language interface, theme customization, and Gitalk/DisqusJS comment systems. It enables local content creation with one-click publishing to platforms like GitHub Pages, featuring OneDrive/iCloud sync for multi-device workflows, ideal for personal knowledge management and content creation.

repos.description: ✨ The agentic HTML editor — your local AI agent writes the HTML, you ship it. 🚀 75 Skills × 9 Surfaces (magazine · deck · poster · XHS / tweet · prototype · data report · Hyperframes) 🛡️ Sandboxed preview · 📤 1-click to WeChat / X / Zhihu / HTML / PNG 🔑 Zero API key — Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Gemini / Copilot / OpenCode / Qwen / Aider.
repos.summary_zh: HTML Anything 是一款本地优先的智能 HTML 编辑器，集成 8 种主流编码代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等），无需 API 密钥。提供 75 个可组合技能模板，支持 9 种输出场景（杂志、海报、数据报告、小红书卡片等），一键导出至微信、X、知乎或生成 HTML/PNG 文件。
repos.summary_en: HTML Anything is a local-first, agentic HTML editor that integrates 8 coding agent CLIs (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) with zero API key required. It offers 75 composable skill templates across 9 deliverable formats—from magazines to data reports—and enables one-click export to WeChat, X, Zhihu, HTML, or PNG.

repos.description: Free and open source database client built natively for developers
repos.summary_zh: TablePro 是一款面向开发者的免费开源原生数据库客户端，支持 macOS、iOS 和 Linux。它摒弃 Electron 和 JVM，采用原生框架构建，冷启动低于 1 秒，内存占用约 80MB。支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis 等主流 SQL/NoSQL 数据库，内置 AI 功能（聊天、代码建议、MCP 服务），并可通过插件扩展。提供 SQL 编辑器、数据网格、SSH 隧道、iCloud 同步等核心功能，是 TablePlus 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: TablePro is a free, open-source native database client for developers, built without Electron or JVM. It supports major SQL and NoSQL databases with native drivers, cold starts under 1 second, and ~80MB RAM usage. Features include an AI-powered SQL editor, data grid, SSH tunnels, iCloud sync, and plugin extensibility. It serves as an open-source alternative to TablePlus with integrated AI chat, MCP server, and cross-platform support.

repos.description: cursor IDE enjoy VIP
repos.summary_zh: cursor-vip 是一个通过共享方式解锁 Cursor IDE 付费 VIP 功能的工具，支持多语言配置与代理模式。它提供稳定的 Claude 模型访问，通过脚本或二进制文件快速部署，适用于开发者绕过区域限制使用高级 AI 编程功能，但稳定性不及官方版本。
repos.summary_en: cursor-vip is a tool that unlocks Cursor IDE's paid VIP features via shared access, supporting multi-language configuration and proxy modes. It offers stable Claude model access, easy deployment via scripts or binaries, and enables developers to use advanced AI coding features despite regional payment restrictions, though with lower stability than the official version.

repos.description: Record your screen, ship a demo. Free and open-source, GPU-accelerated, no watermarks, no subscriptions. Windows, macOS, Linux. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与演示制作工具，作为 Screen Studio 的开源替代方案。支持窗口/全屏录制、自动缩放、光标特效、摄像头画中画、本地 AI 字幕生成及 AI 编辑助手，适用于产品演示、教程视频和社交媒体内容创作，支持 macOS/Windows/Linux 跨平台使用。
repos.summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording and demo creation tool, positioned as an alternative to Screen Studio. It features window/full-screen recording, auto-zooms, cursor effects, webcam overlay, on-device AI captions, and an AI editing assistant. Ideal for product demos, tutorials, and social media content across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: MarkDown在线简历工具，可在线预览、编辑和生成PDF。[此项目已不再维护，建议使用 cv.ftqq.com 替代 ]
repos.summary_zh: DeerResume 是一款功能强大的 Markdown 在线简历工具，支持实时编辑、预览、密码保护和一键生成 PDF。用户可自主部署，自由定制样式，适用于技术岗位简历制作，尤其适合开发者使用。
repos.summary_en: DeerResume is a powerful Markdown-based online resume tool that supports real-time editing, preview, password protection, and PDF generation. It allows self-hosting with customizable styles, making it ideal for developers creating professional tech resumes.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一款面向智能体开发的跨平台桌面应用，将终端、代码编辑器和上下文文件整合在无限画布中，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。基于 Electron 40、React 19 和 Tailwind CSS 4 构建，集成 Monaco 编辑器、xterm.js 终端和 D3 可视化，实现本地优先、无账号的协作开发环境，消除上下文切换，提升智能体协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a cross-platform desktop environment for agentic development, unifying terminals, code editors, and context files on an infinite canvas. Built with Electron 40, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4, it integrates Monaco Editor, xterm.js terminal, and D3 visualization. Designed for local-first, account-free workflows, it eliminates context switching and enhances agent collaboration across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: A better file browser and calendar inspired by Apple Notes, Bear, Evernote and Day One.
repos.summary_zh: Notebook Navigator 是 Obsidian 的一款插件，用简洁的双窗格界面替代默认文件浏览器，支持文件夹树、标签浏览、文件预览、键盘导航、拖拽操作、固定笔记及高度可定制化显示选项，显著提升笔记管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Notebook Navigator is an Obsidian plugin that replaces the default file explorer with a clean two-pane interface, offering folder tree navigation, tag browsing, file previews, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop, pinned notes, and customizable display options for efficient note management.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一个专为 AI 智能体协作设计的 macOS 桌面应用，提供无限画布环境，集成终端、代码编辑器和文件管理功能。支持多工作区、实时终端交互和拖拽式文件操作，采用 Electron + React 技术栈，所有数据本地存储，适用于端到端的智能体开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a macOS-native desktop app for building with AI agents, featuring an infinite canvas workspace with integrated terminals, code editors, and file navigation. It supports multi-workspace management, real-time agent interaction, and local data storage, built on Electron, React, and xterm.js for seamless agentic development.

repos.description: A React markdown editor and previewer.
repos.summary_zh: MarkPlus 是一个功能强大的 React Markdown 编辑器与预览组件，支持实时编辑、多主题切换、可定制工具栏及数学公式、流程图等高级功能。它提供编辑器、预览或双栏模式，适用于内容创作与文档开发场景。
repos.summary_en: MarkPlus is a powerful React-based Markdown editor and previewer with real-time editing, customizable toolbar, multi-theme support, and advanced features like math formulas and flowcharts. It supports editor, preview, or dual-pane modes, ideal for content creation and documentation.

repos.description: A free, elegant Markdown editor for macOS, Windows and Linux. Simple by design, always in sync with the file on disk.
repos.summary_zh: ColaMD 是一款专为 AI 智能体协作设计的原生 Markdown 编辑器，支持实时同步 AI 对 .md 文件的修改，具备 WYSIWYG 编辑、多主题支持和跨平台导出功能。其核心亮点在于通过文件监听实现 AI 操作的无缝可视化，让用户像结对编程一样观察智能体工作过程。
repos.summary_en: ColaMD is an Agent-Native Markdown editor designed for real-time collaboration between humans and AI agents. It instantly reflects AI-generated changes to .md files via file system monitoring, featuring WYSIWYG editing, cross-platform support, and theme customization—eliminating manual refresh cycles during agent-assisted writing.

repos.description: A feature-rich, efficient text editor - Web Site
repos.summary_zh: Yu Writer Site 是一个功能丰富、高效的文本编辑器网站，提供现代化的写作体验。支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、多主题切换和本地存储，适用于内容创作者和开发者。项目采用轻量级架构，注重性能与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: Yu Writer Site is a feature-rich, efficient text editor web application offering a modern writing experience. It supports Markdown editing, live preview, multi-theme switching, and local storage, ideal for content creators and developers. Built with a lightweight architecture focused on performance and user experience.

repos.description: 清理Augment缓存和生成设备SessionId/解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件无法登录的问题（Sign in failed. If you have a firewall, please add）/将所有 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 域名统一指向延迟最低的服务器IP
repos.summary_zh: Augment 插件清理工具 v3.4 是一款专为解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件登录失败问题而设计的跨平台工具。核心功能包括彻底清理插件缓存数据、生成设备 SessionId，以及通过智能测速优化 API 域名解析（将 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 指向延迟最低服务器）。支持交互式菜单和命令行模式，提供代理配置、安全预览等高级功能，兼容 Windows/macOS/Linux。
repos.summary_en: Augment Plugin Cleaner v3.4 is a cross-platform utility designed to resolve login failures in Augment plugin for VSCode, Cursor, and JetBrains IDEs. It features comprehensive cache/data cleanup, SessionId generation, and intelligent API domain optimization by testing latency of d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com endpoints. Supports interactive menus, CLI arguments, proxy configurations (Clash/V2Ray/custom), dry-run previews, and works on Windows/macOS/Linux with admin privileges for hosts file modification.

repos.description: [UNMAINTAINED] Online reStructuredText editor
repos.summary_zh: rsted 是一个基于 Flask 的在线 reStructuredText 编辑器，提供实时预览功能，支持通过 Docker 快速部署。虽然项目已停止维护，但可作为轻量级 RST 文档编辑工具使用，适合快速编写和预览技术文档。
repos.summary_en: rsted is a simple online reStructuredText editor built with Flask, offering real-time preview. Though unmaintained, it provides a lightweight solution for editing and previewing RST documents, deployable via Docker or local server on port 5000.

repos.description: Create stunning screen recordings for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: CursorLens 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为创作者、开发者和团队设计。基于 OpenScreen 构建，深度优化 macOS 原生捕获流程，支持全屏/窗口录制、摄像头画中画、语音录制、时间轴剪辑、字幕生成及多比例导出，无水印且商用免费。
repos.summary_en: CursorLens is a free, open-source screen recorder and editor built on OpenScreen, enhanced for native macOS capture and editing. It supports full-screen/app recording, camera overlay, voice input, timeline editing, subtitle generation, and multi-aspect export—all watermark-free and commercially usable.

repos.description: A smart and beautiful markdown editor.
repos.summary_zh: Markcook 是一款基于 Vue 2.0 和 Vuex 2.0 开发的智能美观 Markdown 编辑器，采用 Google Material Design 风格。支持多文件切换、拖拽加载、自动保存至本地存储、一键插入 Markdown 语法及导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，提供流畅的动画交互与护眼配色，兼具在线便捷性与本地应用体验。
repos.summary_en: Markcook is a smart and beautiful markdown editor built with VueJS 2.0 and Vuex 2.0, featuring Google Material Design. It supports multi-file editing, drag-and-drop loading, auto-save to local storage, toolbar-based markdown insertion, and export to .md or .html. With smooth animations, low-contrast colors, and componentized architecture, it offers a seamless online experience akin to desktop apps.

repos.description: :zap: Sync all of your VSCode settings across multiple devices, supports any VSCode variant.
repos.summary_zh: VSCode Syncing 是一款强大的 VSCode 扩展，支持跨设备同步用户设置、键位绑定、扩展、语言包和代码片段至 GitHub Gist。支持增量同步、自动安装扩展、代理配置，并兼容 VSCodium、Cursor 等 VSCode 衍生版本。
repos.summary_en: VSCode Syncing is a powerful extension that synchronizes all VSCode settings—including user settings, keybindings, extensions, snippets, and locales—across multiple devices via GitHub Gist. It supports incremental sync, automatic extension management, proxy configuration, and works with any VSCode variant like VSCodium and Cursor.

repos.description: DjangoUeditor
repos.summary_zh: DjangoUeditor 是一个用于在 Django 项目中集成百度 UEditor 富文本编辑器的 Python 模块，支持强大的 HTML 编辑功能（如拖拽调整表格单元格），提供灵活的上传路径配置和自定义按钮扩展，适用于内容管理系统、博客等富文本编辑场景。
repos.summary_en: DjangoUeditor is a Python module that integrates Baidu UEditor, a powerful online HTML editor, into Django applications. It supports advanced editing features like drag-and-drop table cells and offers flexible image/file upload configurations, custom buttons, and admin integration, ideal for CMS and blog platforms.

repos.description: WeSight Obsidian plugin for local agent runtimes.
repos.summary_zh: WeSight Obsidian 插件将 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等本地 AI 代理集成至 Obsidian 笔记系统，提供侧边栏聊天、内联编辑、文件引用与斜杠命令等功能。支持互联网快照分享、飞书文档同步及微信公众号草稿发布，实现 AI 协作与多平台内容分发的无缝衔接。
repos.summary_en: WeSight Obsidian plugin integrates local AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode directly into your Obsidian vault. Features include sidebar chat, inline editing, file mentions, and slash commands. It supports internet snapshot sharing, Feishu document sync, and WeChat Official Account draft publishing, enabling seamless AI collaboration and multi-platform content distribution.

repos.description: Django markdown support and wysiwig
repos.summary_zh: Django-Markdown 是一个为 Django 框架提供 Markdown 富文本编辑支持的扩展应用，支持在模型字段、表单、管理后台及静态页面中集成所见即所得（WYSIWYG）编辑器，内置预览功能和可配置扩展，适用于内容管理系统（CMS）和文档类 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Django-Markdown is a Django app enabling Markdown WYSIWYG editing in models, forms, admin interfaces, and flatpages. It integrates a rich text editor with preview functionality, configurable extensions, and admin overrides, ideal for CMS and documentation-driven web applications.

repos.description: A cross-platform skills manager for AI IDEs. Search marketplace, download locally, and install to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and more with one click.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款跨平台 AI IDE 技能管理工具，支持聚合搜索 Claude、Cursor、Windsurf 等10+主流AI开发环境的技能插件，一键下载至本地统一仓库并通过安全符号链接快速安装，提供版本控制、批量部署和自定义IDE支持，显著提升AI编程助手的功能扩展效率。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a cross-platform AI IDE skills management tool that aggregates search across major marketplaces (Claude Plugins, SkillsLLM, etc.), downloads skills to a unified local repository, and enables one-click installation into 10+ supported AI IDEs via secure symlinks. It features version control, bulk deployment, and custom IDE support for enhanced AI programming assistant capabilities.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastMCP 框架的 VSCode 扩展，将 VSCode 转换为 MCP 服务器，支持通过 HTTP Streaming 和 SSE 协议远程执行内部命令，提供工作区信息查询、异步执行、命令白名单等能力，兼容 Model Context Protocol 标准。
repos.summary_en: A VSCode extension using FastMCP framework to convert VSCode into an MCP server, enabling remote execution of internal commands via HTTP Streaming and SSE, with workspace info, async execution, command whitelisting, and full Model Context Protocol compatibility.

repos.description: Yet Another Pair Programming Package for Atom.
repos.summary_zh: Coeditor 是一个为 Atom 编辑器设计的实时协同编程插件，支持多用户无冲突文本编辑、语法高亮同步、文件操作同步及项目级协作感知。通过自建 WebSocket 服务器实现客户端间状态同步，适用于远程结对编程场景，需统一配置换行符以避免内容不一致。
repos.summary_en: Coeditor is a real-time collaborative programming plugin for Atom, enabling conflict-free text editing, syntax highlighting sync, file operations, and project awareness across multiple users. It relies on a custom WebSocket server for state synchronization, ideal for remote pair programming, with strict line ending consistency requirements across clients.
